description: This file defines the RouteParser class within the Slim framework, responsible for generating URLs based on route names and parameters, handling URL parsing, and constructing full URLs with base paths and URI components.

classes.name: RouteParser
classes.description: Implements route URL generation and parsing logic for the Slim framework, conforming to RouteParserInterface.

methods.name: relativeUrlFor
methods.description: Generates a relative URL for a named route, substituting placeholders with provided data and appending query parameters.

methods.name: urlFor
methods.description: Generates a complete URL for a named route, including the base path.

methods.name: fullUrlFor
methods.description: Constructs a full URL including scheme, authority, and path based on a provided UriInterface and route data.
